mount_table.rationale: A private tmpfs root prevents accidental host-root writes and makes teardown automatic.
The selected host store or extracted release closure is exposed read-only without copying bytes into the namespace.
A fresh tmpfs home prevents host session files from becoming ambient state and is destroyed on exit.
Durable state at meta/var/lib/postgresql and the surrounding meta/var plane is caller-declared and remains across envelope exit.
A private process namespace receives a proc view scoped to the envelope lifecycle.
The device surface is private by default and expanded only by explicit GPU or device acquisition.
